integrity: Exact finite support formula, explicit limiting integral, analytic first-moment derivation, and reproducible direct numerical diagnostics are provided; finite tests are not proofs of infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: Only a single possibly large parallel class; q goes to infinity with p/q approaching a finite nonnegative constant. Classical normal point-process limits are proved from Gaussian tails; no independent validation has been performed. Geometric novelty is assessed against the accessible identified literature, not asserted absolutely.
title: A Poisson crossover and sharp mean-width loss for clipped rank-two matroid polytopes
